annotation_lead: Hailay Kidu Teklehaymanot led the Tigrinya annotation effort for FineWeb-C, organizing the Tigrinya community and annotating the Tigrinya (tir_Ethi) data, as acknowledged at https://huggingface.co/spaces/data-is-better-together/FineWeb-C-Contributors
processing_steps: Duplicate removal: deleting identical or highly redundant rows
note: processed_size (745) is independently confirmed: it matches both the committed train/dev/test.csv row counts in this directory (597+74+74) and the tir_Ethi config's row count reported by the data-is-better-together/fineweb-c dataset itself. original_size (2,500) is not independently verifiable from anything committed in this repository -- it is recorded as stated by the Tigrinya annotation lead. This dataset is unrelated to data/tc/amharic/, which has its own separate source and figures.
